messages.subject: Size Distribution Analysis Feedback
parts:
Dear D-RUGgies,

 

I am looking for some visualization and analysis feedback on some of my experimental results. I am trying to understand how filter feeding animals affect the size distribution of their phytoplankton prey. Attached is a figure showing the size distribution of cultured phytoplankton cells in the absence or presence of a variety of filter feeders. Each dark gray line is the size distribution for an individual replicate, while the transparent blue lines are the generalized additive model predictions for the control treatment that I overlaid on each panel/facet. The light gray line highlights zero on the y-axis and shows the log-distributed size classes at which my instrument measures particle volume.

 

I want to make statistical inference on how the size distribution changed for each species relative to the control and other species, including the height of the distribution and its shape (e.g. did some species filter small or large cells particularly well?). I've worked with GAM’s and GAMM’s but interpreting the results is not always clear to me (and I'm not sure I am calculating the correct confidence intervals). If you have any suggestions for other ways to analyze or visualize these results, please chime in. I really appreciate your feedback.

 

Many thanks,

 

Matt
